name: Interpersonal Behavior and Team Dynamics
description: This course will help students understand the nature and characteristics of teams, differences across team types, and key elements impacting team dynamics such as group identity, norms, trust, psychological safety, power, leadership, and conflict. Students will understand the ingredients of high-performing teams and learn to identify and manage dysfunctional team behaviors and build effective / high-performing teams. This course will draw upon research driven knowledge to understand and implement effective strategies to improve interpersonal dynamics and develop effective teams. The course will integrate reflections on contemporary issues at work and industry relevant examples of how these are managed.
